test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: By selling 30 metres of cloth a shopkeeper makes a profit equivalent to the selling price of 10 metres of cloth. Find the selling price of 1 metre of cloth when the cost price of 1 metre of cloth is Rs. 480.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 1 metre of cloth = Rs. 480

Profit from selling 30 metres of cloth = Selling price of 10 metres of cloth

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Total profit from selling 30 metres = Selling price of 30 metres - Cost price of 30 metres

Selling price of 10 metres = 10 × Selling price of 1 metre

**Calculation:**

Let the selling price of 1 metre of cloth be Rs. x.

Profit from selling 30 metres = 30x - 30 × 480

Given that,

30x - 30 × 480 = 10x

⇒ 30x - 14400 = 10x

⇒ 30x - 10x = 14400

⇒ 20x = 14400

⇒ x = 14400 / 20

⇒ x = 720

**The selling price of 1 metre of cloth is Rs. 720.**
